$comment: The platform's MCP tools (lib/mcp.js), declared as data: what each tool is called, what it takes, which engine answers it, the capability a store must have on, and who may call it (audience: shopper = anyone the store serves, staff = a store role with the right grant). The same tools are what the platform's own AI assistant calls, so one definition serves every app and every MCP client.

TOOLS.name: knowledge_search
TOOLS.title: Search the knowledge base
TOOLS.description: Search a knowledge collection of this store for approved entries that answer a question, optionally narrowed by tags (e.g. planet:mars, house:7). Returns the entries with their titles, text and tags.

q.description: The question or words to search for

tags.description: Tags that the entries must carry at least one of

TOOLS.name: knowledge_collections
TOOLS.title: List knowledge collections
TOOLS.description: List this store's knowledge collections with their labels.

TOOLS.name: astro_chart
TOOLS.title: Compute a birth chart
TOOLS.description: Compute a birth chart from a birth date, time, time zone and place: each body's sign, degree, nakshatra, pada and house, the ascendant, the houses, and the Vimshottari dasha periods, with this store's astrology settings.

TOOLS.name: astro_panchang
TOOLS.title: The panchang for a day
TOOLS.description: The panchang (tithi, paksha, vara, nakshatra, yoga, karana) at a date, time and place.

TOOLS.name: astro_match
TOOLS.title: Kundli matching
TOOLS.description: Ashtakoota (guna milan) matching of two births: each koota's points out of its maximum and the total out of 36.

first.description: A birth: date, time, timeZone or utcOffsetMinutes, latitude, longitude

second.description: A birth: date, time, timeZone or utcOffsetMinutes, latitude, longitude

TOOLS.name: records_list
TOOLS.title: List records of a type
TOOLS.description: List records of one of this store's data types (any type defined in Data Studio, or a built-in one), as the calling role is allowed to see them.

type.description: The data type key, e.g. supplier

staff.label: A store role with the grant
